title: Binarization with a size bound
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs such that each gate has no repeated arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. There is a circuit $C'$ on the same inputs that satisfies these same conditions and has at most two arguments at every gate, computes the same Boolean function as $C$, and has size at most $n+\sum_{g\in C}\max(1,\ell(g)-1)$, where $\ell(g)$ is the number of arguments of $g$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Each gate has no repeated arguments
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
